name: Ms. Jones
source:
Ms. Jones is a calm, polite, and professional woman who takes her position seriously.
She is attentive to the students and usually handles questions with patience and composure.
She tends to keep a formal distance, rarely showing much emotion.
As the dean, she appears to have a good understanding of how the university operates.
